title: Later Lessons
text:
Many people think that school days should start later in the morning. They say students need more sleep to learn well. In this passage, a student named Tomek explains his opinion. He believes the change would help everyone.

Tomek also argues that students would be less tired in class. He thinks teachers would have more energy too. He ends his essay by asking the school board to consider the idea. He hopes they will agree.

questions.text: Why do people say students need more sleep?
Who does Tomek ask to consider his idea?
Why does Tomek write this essay?
options: To persuade the school board to change the start time
To complain about one of his teachers
To ask for a longer holiday

questions.text: What can we infer about the students at this school?
options: They are often tired during lessons
They enjoy early lessons very much
They do not like going to school
They live very far from the school

vocabulary.definition: what a person thinks or believes about something
gives reasons to show that something is true or right
think carefully about something before deciding

paragraph_translations: Wiele osób uważa, że lekcje w szkole powinny zaczynać się później rano. Mówią, że uczniowie potrzebują więcej snu, żeby dobrze się uczyć. W tym tekście uczeń o imieniu Tomek wyjaśnia swoją opinię. Uważa, że ta zmiana pomogłaby wszystkim.

Tomek twierdzi również, że uczniowie byliby mniej zmęczeni na lekcjach. Uważa, że nauczyciele też mieliby więcej energii. Na końcu swojego wypracowania prosi radę szkoły, żeby rozważyła ten pomysł. Ma nadzieję, że się zgodzą.
